resonance_coefficient_max.rationale: Resonance coefficient upper bound: 1.5 = 三勢力全對齊 (foreign + institutional + government all aligned). Bound on ComputeResonance in internal/capitalflow/resonance.go:13. Tied to PR #1007 invariant test.

resonance_coefficient_min.rationale: Resonance coefficient lower bound: 0.5 = foreign vs government 對立. Bound on ComputeResonance in internal/capitalflow/resonance.go:13. Tied to PR #1007 invariant test.

trend_bullish_threshold.rationale: Z-score cutoff for bullish force trend (trendFor): z > threshold → bullish. Legacy hardcoded 0.5 kept as default (audit M8); mirrors the parameterized-threshold convention of PeriodDetectionConfig.

trend_bearish_threshold.rationale: Z-score cutoff for bearish force trend (trendFor): z < threshold → bearish. Legacy hardcoded -0.5 kept as default (audit M8); mirrors the parameterized-threshold convention of PeriodDetectionConfig.
